Implementation Plan

## Implementation plan: finalize the `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-06.md` triage (Refs #8924)

**Planning ref:** `orchestrator/project-8924` at `3ba244cd70cfbed89f5235ad3f760df6b301c14a`. Integration branch mismatch: false.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` (the existing per-source-doc ledger section shape)
Scope-mode justification: The issue asks for two things: delete one source doc and add one ledger section plus one list entry to the existing report. The change copies the shape of the existing `### \`analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-03-2.md\`` section (heading, `Source doc:`, `Processed:`, `Source commit:`, a provenance line with `Refs #N`, then a `| Recommendation | Verdict | Evidence / reason |` table). No new scripts, helpers or tests are needed. `tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py` builds its own report in a temp directory (line 108) and never reads the real report, so it needs no edit. The issue limits the change to two files, so the plan does not widen it, even where the ref contradicts the issue (see D2). There is no complete-vs-shortcut choice under the Boil the Lake rule, because the complete ledger is the deliverable.

## Files likely to change
- `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-06.md` (deleted)
- `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`

## Automation / scheduling (§20.E)
- This change only edits and deletes existing files. It adds no script and extends none.
- Scheduler entry point: none new. The doc reached this project through the existing apply-analysis cycle, which skips docs already listed under `## Processed source docs`.
- No long-running supervisor is needed. There is no DB work and no entry for `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`.

## Functions or modules to implement
None. This is a documentation and ledger change only.

1. Delete `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-06.md`.
   - Do not touch `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-06-2.md`, a separate doc whose name is close to this one.
   - Do not touch any other `analysis/` file, including `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt` and `analysis/validation-selftest-status.json`.
   - The doc is mentioned only in comments, never read by code: `scripts/check_integration_pr_readiness.py:217` and `tests/test_check_integration_pr_readiness.py:325`. Deleting it breaks nothing.
2. In `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`:
   - **Heading count.** Line 5 changes from `## Processed source docs (132)` to `## Processed source docs (133)`. 132 matches the 132 bullets now on lines 8–139.
   - **List entry.** Insert `` - `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-06.md` `` right after line 139 (`` - `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-03-2.md` ``), before the blank line and `## Downstream local issue ID recheck`.
   - **New section.** Append it after the last line of the file (line 2048, the final row of the 2026-10-03-2 table), with one blank line in between. Change nothing else in the file.

The table rows below are in the issue's order. I checked each code citation on the planning ref; the implementer re-runs the same searches on the implement ref before writing each row.

- **BUG-002 (missing `ai:orchestrator-tracking` label passed readiness): applied.**
  - `scripts/check_integration_pr_readiness.py` posts `failure` and logs `::error::[integration-pr-readiness] issue #N is not labeled ai:orchestrator-tracking`. With the `ai:override-incomplete-merge` override label (`OVERRIDE_LABEL`, line 60) on the PR, it posts `success` instead.
  - Tests: `tests/test_check_integration_pr_readiness.py`.
  - Fragment: `changelog.d/8925-readiness-fail-closed-missing-tracking-label.md`. Refs #8924.
- **SHELL-001 (unquoted repo root in the prefix-strip): verdict depends on the implement ref. See D2.**
  - If lines 109–110 of `write_guard_check()` in `scripts/write_guard.sh` quote the root (`#"${write_guard_root_dir}"/`) and `python3 -m unittest tests.test_write_guard_root_pattern_chars` passes, write `applied`. Evidence: the quoted expansions in `write_guard_check()` and test `tests/test_write_guard_root_pattern_chars.py`. No fragment is visible (`changelog.d` has none).
  - If the expansions are still unquoted (as on the planning ref), write `deferred`. Evidence: "the regression test `tests/test_write_guard_root_pattern_chars.py` is on this ref, but `write_guard_check()` in `scripts/write_guard.sh` still strips with the unquoted `${write_guard_config_log_path#${write_guard_root_dir}/}`, unchanged from the default branch, so the glob-character cases in that test fail; the quoting fix still has to land".
- **SEC-001 (`github.ref_name` in `run:` bodies): already-implemented.**
  - No `${{ github.ref_name }}` appears inside a `run:` body anywhere under `.github/workflows/`.
  - `test-and-mark-stable.yml:173` passes it through `env: DISPATCH_REF_NAME`, and `mark-stable.yml` has none.
  - `workflow-log-analysis.yml:71` uses it only in `concurrency.group`.
  - Every other use is an `env:`, `concurrency`, `with:`/matrix value or an input description. Examples: `nightly-validation-selftest.yml:238,328`, `review_autofix.yml:3629` (`HEAD_REF`), `internal-review.yml:50`, `comprehensive-test-and-release.yml:26`, `publish-sandbox-images.yml:62`.

## Decisions
### D1 — Append-only ledger section copying the 2026-10-03-2 shape
- **Chosen:** A new section at the end of the file, with the same headings, provenance line and table columns as the 2026-10-03-2 section. Only line 5 and the list gain content elsewhere.
- **Alternatives considered:** Merging the rows into an older grouped "Outcome ledger" section; rewriting the sections that came before.
- **Why:** The issue requires append-only edits with no reflow, and every recent doc uses one section per doc.

### D2 — SHELL-001 verdict follows the ref, not the issue text
- **Chosen:** Record `applied` only if the quoting fix is present on the implement ref. Otherwise record `deferred` with the evidence above. Do not edit `scripts/write_guard.sh`.
- **Alternatives considered:** Record `applied` as the issue says; add the two-line quoting fix in this PR; block the plan.
- **Why:**
